in_sanskrit.name: Angrej
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler of the Earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Angrej एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Angrej is derived from the Sanskrit term 'angaraja', which translates to 'ruler of the earth'. This powerful and grounding name is rooted in Hindu mythology and carries a strong sense of leadership and connection to the natural world.
